subject: ss-medical-oncology
title: Advanced prostate cancer: metastatic castration-sensitive disease, castration-resistant progression, androgen receptor inhibitors and radioligand therapy

steps.tx: First-line systemic therapy for metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer **mHSPC** mandates intensifying androgen deprivation therapy with either doublet or triplet combination regimens. Landmark trials demonstrated that adding docetaxel chemotherapy or novel androgen receptor pathway inhibitors **abiraterone**, **enzalutamide**, or **apalutamide** produces dramatic, statistically significant improvements in radiographic progression-free survival and overall survival over ADT monotherapy.

rows: Fatigue, hypertension, falls, rare seizure risk

steps.tx: In patients with high-volume mHSPC, the randomized phase III **ARASENS** and **PEACE-1** trials proved that systemic triplet therapy significantly prolongs overall survival. Combining ADT and 6 cycles of docetaxel with novel androgen receptor pathway inhibitors **darolutamide** or abiraterone reduced the hazard of death by over 25%, establishing triplet therapy as the preferred standard of care for fit patients with de novo high-volume metastatic disease.

left.title: ARASENS Triplet
points: Minimal central nervous system adverse events

right.title: PEACE-1 Triplet
points: Statistically significant OS gain in high-volume
Proves efficacy of dual hormonal and cytotoxic upfront block

steps.tx: Targeted radioligand therapy with **Lutetium-177-PSMA-617** delivers beta-emitting radiation specifically to prostate-specific membrane antigen-expressing tumour lesions. In the landmark phase III **VISION trial**, adding Lutetium-177-PSMA-617 to standard care in pretreated PSMA-positive metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer **mCRPC** significantly improved both progression-free survival and overall survival, establishing theranostics in advanced prostate cancer.

steps.tx: The whole body scan lights up widespread nodal and bone deposits that take up prostate specific membrane antigen tracer. Such **PSMA avid disease** in **metastatic castration resistant cancer** can be targeted by **lutetium PSMA therapy**, which delivers cell killing beta particles to tracer positive sites. The VISION approach selects patients by scan positivity so radiation concentrates in tumour rather than normal tissue. Link the bright scan spots to this treatment choice.
steps.say: This image shows metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer on PSMA PET with matching axial views of involved nodes and bones. Bright tracer uptake marks prostate specific membrane antigen on tumour cells throughout the skeleton and retroperitoneum. When disease shows this pattern after standard systemic therapy, lutetium PSMA treatment can deliver focused beta radiation to those same sites. The scan therefore serves both as a map of spread and as the eligibility test for radioligand therapy.

vis.alt: Whole body and axial PET views show widespread tracer avid nodal and bone metastases.
vis.caption: PSMA PET maps nodal and skeletal disease for radioligand selection. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: In metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer harbouring deleterious alterations in homologous recombination repair genes, the phase III **PROfound trial** established the PARP inhibitor **olaparib**. In cohort A, comprising patients with **BRCA1**, **BRCA2**, or **ATM** alterations progressing on enzalutamide or abiraterone, olaparib produced a statistically significant overall survival benefit, proving synthetic lethality in DNA damage-deficient prostate cancer.

left.title: PROfound Cohort A (BRCA/ATM)
points: Patients with BRCA1, BRCA2, or ATM alterations

right.title: Control Arm (Enzalutamide/Abiraterone)
points: Re-challenge with alternative AR pathway inhibitor
Rapid disease progression without survival gain
Reinforces ineffectiveness of sequential ARPI monotherapy

steps.tx: Targeted bone-seeking alpha-emitting radiopharmaceutical **Radium-223** mimics calcium, forming complexes with hydroxyapatite in areas of high osteoblastic bone turnover. In the phase III ALSYMPCA trial, radium-223 significantly prolonged overall survival and delayed symptomatic skeletal-related events in **mCRPC with symptomatic bone metastases** without visceral disease, delivering high-energy linear radiation that induces lethal double-strand DNA breaks.

steps.tx: Second-generation semi-synthetic taxane **Cabazitaxel** was engineered with diminished affinity for the P-glycoprotein multidrug resistance efflux pump, effectively overcoming docetaxel resistance. In the landmark **CARD trial**, cabazitaxel significantly doubled overall survival and radiographic progression-free survival compared to a second androgen receptor pathway inhibitor in patients with mCRPC previously treated with docetaxel and experiencing progression within 12 months.

rows: Significantly superior survival and pain response
Cabazitaxel preferred over sequential ARPI post-docetaxel

steps.tx: Biologically, **Castration-resistant prostate cancer** is formally defined as objective disease progression occurring despite castrate levels of circulating serum testosterone **below 50 ng/dL** or 1.7 nmol/L. Progression manifests as three consecutive rising serum PSA values measured at least 1 week apart resulting in two 50% increases over nadir, or objective radiographic appearance of two or more new bone lesions on scintigraphy.

left.title: Castrate Serum Testosterone
points: Mandates continuation of GnRH agonist or antagonist
Maintained indefinitely throughout all CRPC therapies

right.title: Criteria for Progression
points: PSA rise: 3 consecutive increases > 50% over nadir
Radiographic: 2 or more new bone scan lesions

steps.tx: Aggressive **treatment-emergent neuroendocrine prostate cancer** **t-NEPC** arises via **lineage plasticity** under intense androgen receptor pressure. Characterized by rapid visceral metastases, lytic bone lesions, and disproportionately low serum PSA, this aggressive variant is molecularly driven by TP53 and RB1 co-loss. Systemic management requires prompt initiation of platinum and etoposide chemotherapy regimens identical to small cell neuroendocrine protocols.
